statement.p: Find the value(s) of a making \vec v = 6 a\,\vec i - 2\, \vec j parallel to \vec w = a^2\,\vec i + 6\, \vec j.

p.em: (If there is more than one value of a, enter the values as a comma-separated list.)

static.solution: a\ne 0, \frac{a^2}{6 a} = \frac{6}{-2}. Solving, and noticing that a = 0 also gives parallel vectors, gives a = 0, -18.
